_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: categories, cardinality (max -1 = unbounded), accepted formats, tooltip help. Chimera renders and enforces; this file decides. Slot ids are what project manifests record.

slots.title: UMD disc
slots.help: The PSP game: a UMD dump as .iso or compressed .cso, or homebrew (EBOOT .pbp, a raw .prx or .elf).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the memory stick holds already saved when the PSP starts: the zip that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes, put back as it is, or a zip of save folders taken off a memory stick (ULUS10041DATA00, with its PARAM.SFO, icons and the game's files), which go under PSP/SAVEDATA. It is unpacked onto the memory stick before the machine starts, mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it, so a run that starts from a saved game reproduces like one that starts from nothing. Leave it empty and the stick has no saves.

slots.title: DLC
slots.help: Downloadable content: a zip of the game's DLC folder as a memory stick holds it (ULUS10336, with the EDAT files and PARAM.PBP inside), which goes under PSP/GAME - or a zip of the memory stick itself, whose PSP/ tree goes where it says. Unpacked onto the memory stick before the machine starts and pinned by hash like the save data. Several zips may be given.
